title: Meter Reconciliation Results — Sample B (2026-02) | Streaming + Retries Coverage
content:
Doc purpose
- Sample B is the February reconciliation pass focused on expanded coverage for:
  (1) streaming partial completions + disconnect handling and
  (2) retries / duplicate attempts across endpoints.
- This sheet summarizes the variance distribution between:
  A) source telemetry aggregates ("raw usage") and
  B) billing-ready aggregates used for invoice line items ("invoice agg").
- Output is intended as audit support for Finance + an execution checklist for Telemetry/Platform.

Scope (Sample B)
- Invoice cycle: 2026-02 (operational window used for this sample: 2026-02-01 through 2026-02-14, inclusive; UTC days)
- Products: Hosted API only (chat + completions + embeddings + rerank)
- Regions: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1 (include cross-region failover cases when present)
- Dimensions validated (where available in both datasets): customer_id, workspace_id, model, endpoint_type, region, is_streaming, request_outcome (partial), retry_reason (partial)
- Exclusions:
  - Dedicated usage attribution (handled in a separate workstream)
  - Internal Redwood test workspaces
  - Backfill runs flagged with invoice_run_id containing "BACKFILL" (see Known false positives)

Datasets / sources of truth
- Raw usage (telemetry): rw_telemetry.request_usage_v1 (per-request events; includes token counts and request lifecycle markers)
- Billing-ready aggregates: rw_billing.meter_agg_daily_v3 (daily aggregates per meter + dims)
- Invoice preview: rw_billing.invoice_line_items_preview (joins meter_agg_daily_v3 to pricing + rounding)

Acceptance thresholds (proposed for Feb close)
- Primary acceptance: absolute delta <= 0.50% for total tokens (input+output) by customer_id across the 14-day window.
- Secondary acceptance (dimensional): absolute delta <= 1.00% for model x region breakdown for the same window.
- Hard stop (requires investigation before invoicing or documented exception):
  - absolute delta > 2.00% at customer_id total OR
  - negative billed usage for any token meter OR
  - missing region or model dimension rate > 0.10% of requests.

Important: we expect small non-zero deltas due to (a) late-arriving telemetry within the window and (b) request de-duplication logic differences during retry storms. For Sample B, we specifically want to ensure deltas are explainable and trend toward zero with the new request_outcome/retry_reason dims (ENG-4823).

Summary results (Sample B)
- Accounts sampled: 18 customer workspaces (mix: self-serve + enterprise), intentionally biased toward streaming-heavy and retry-heavy workloads.
- Total sampled usage (telemetry basis):
  - Chat/completions tokens: 9.84B total tokens
  - Embeddings units: 2.11B embedding tokens (reported as “embedding_units” in billing)
  - Rerank units: 64.2M documents reranked
- Delta distribution (customer-level totals, tokens only):
  - p50 absolute delta: 0.18%
  - p90 absolute delta: 0.62%
  - p95 absolute delta: 1.04%
  - max absolute delta: 3.41% (1 account; streaming disconnect behavior; see Row 12)
- Pass/fail against thresholds:
  - 15/18 pass primary acceptance (<= 0.50%)
  - 17/18 pass secondary acceptance (<= 1.00%)
  - 1/18 triggers hard stop (Row 12)

Interpretation notes
- Most accounts improved vs January sampling due to removal of per-request rounding in invoice aggregator (see PR: pr_41888 referenced in Confluence ADR-027; not in scope to validate here but shows up as lower systematic bias).
- Remaining variance clusters into:
  1) streaming disconnect accounting (token attribution after client disconnect)
  2) retry double-counting for one endpoint route (legacy completions route w/ client-side retries)
  3) time zone boundary confusion when customers compare console vs invoice (not a meter defect; console alignment tracked under ENG-4825)

Known false positives / suppressions
- Backfills: During 2026-02-18 to 2026-02-19, SRE ran a partial backfill for streaming metrics in eu-west-1. Any reconciliation jobs that include those days should suppress alerts by invoice_run_id prefix (see Slack #eng-sre 1707520093).
- Late telemetry: For high-volume streaming accounts, late-arriving events (up to ~6 hours) can cause daily diffs but should net out over the 14-day window. We therefore evaluate totals over the full window, not per-day pass/fail.

Action items (owners)
- [HARD STOP] Row 12: Investigate + confirm customer impact; if confirmed, coordinate credit/backfill plan (Nadia Rahman + Emily Stone; tie to ENG-4822 / PR pr_41903)
- Row 7: Validate retry de-dup logic for /v1/completions legacy route; confirm that “retry_reason” is being populated end-to-end (Logan Wright + Cole Summers; ENG-4823 / PR pr_41917)
- Console alignment follow-up: ensure any customer-facing explanation references console time zone normalization (Chloe Martin; ENG-4825 / PR pr_41941)
- Add reconciliation evidence bundle to close checklist (Emily Stone; INT-944)

Table: Customer-level reconciliation (tokens)
Legend:
- Telemetry tokens = SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens) from raw usage events
- Invoice agg tokens = SUM(billed_input_tokens + billed_output_tokens) from meter_agg_daily_v3
- Delta% = (Invoice - Telemetry) / Telemetry
- Status = PASS, WARN (>0.50% but <=2.00%), HARD STOP (>2.00% or other criteria)

Non-token meters spot-check (embeddings + rerank)
- Embeddings: 6 accounts spot-checked for embedding_units.
  - p50 absolute delta: 0.12%
  - p95 absolute delta: 0.48%
  - max absolute delta: 0.73% (one eu-west-1 account; likely late telemetry)
  - No hard stop conditions.
- Rerank: 4 accounts spot-checked for rerank_units.
  - All within 0.30% absolute delta.
  - One account had missing model alias mapping in console (not invoice) -> route to console alignment (ENG-4825).

Variance drivers (expanded notes)
1) Streaming disconnect accounting
- Pattern: invoice agg > telemetry by 2–4% specifically on accounts with >85% streaming requests.
- Hypothesis: the aggregator counts tokens generated after disconnect due to delayed stop signal propagation in the streaming controller.
- Next step: confirm whether PR pr_41903 is deployed in all regions for the window; if not, quantify impacted period and plan backfill + customer comms.

2) Retries / duplicate attempts
- Pattern: legacy /v1/completions accounts with high client retry rate show invoice agg > telemetry.
- Hypothesis: raw telemetry is de-duping by request_id but invoice agg is summing attempt-level events without a stable attempt_group key.
- Next step: ensure request_outcome + retry_reason dims are used to exclude non-billed outcomes (ENG-4823); verify cardinality constraints didn’t drop fields.

3) Customer comparisons (console vs invoice)
- Not a reconciliation defect per se, but shows up as tickets.
- When customers compare on local time, console day boundaries drift vs invoice UTC window.
- Console alignment fix is tracked in ENG-4825 (time zone normalization + model alias mapping).

Close readiness recommendation (as of 2026-02-24)
- Proceed with invoicing for passing and WARN accounts with documented deltas <= 1.00% and clear variance attribution.
- Do not invoice (or hold line items) for HARD STOP rows until:
  - engineering confirms fix status + impacted window,
  - Finance approves any needed credits, and
  - we generate an evidence bundle (before/after aggregates + query links + sign-off).

Sign-off checklist (to be completed)
- Finance (Billing controls): Pending — Emily Stone
- Engineering (Metering pipelines): Pending — Nadia Rahman
- Telemetry/Analytics: Pending — Logan Wright
- SRE/Observability (alerts & suppressions): Pending — Allison Grant

Notes to self / open questions
- Do we want to tighten the primary acceptance threshold to 0.25% once ENG-4823 dims are fully deployed? (ask Logan + Nadia)
- Should WARN accounts above 0.50% trigger automatic customer-facing proactive note, or keep internal-only unless they open a ticket? (ask Rachel Kim + Dev Patel)
- Confirm whether we should treat “server-side retries” differently from “client-side retries” in metering definitions (might need Confluence update + FAQ alignment).
